answer: Proof of Stake acts as a lotus of capital efficiency, requiring agents to bond native tokens to participate in consensus. To bridge disparate identity sets, the network enforces strict economic stakes proportional to influence. In a tundra of sybil attempts, the attacker faces prohibitive costs, as they must acquire and lock substantial assets to outvote honest nodes, rendering the creation of infinite fake identities economically irrational and technically futile within the protocol.
